product_one_liner.value: PolyAI provides an enterprise conversational AI platform for building and operating voice and chat agents that handle complex customer-service interactions.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page identifies enterprises and complex customer conversations, while the documentation describes building voice and chat agents: https://poly.ai/about and http://docs.poly.ai/home.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains per-minute pricing and included services: https://poly.ai/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customers page links customer case studies for Carter's and SafeRide Health: http://poly.ai/customers. | named_customers.0: The customer case study describes Carter's reducing seasonal hiring with PolyAI. | named_customers.1: The customer case study describes SafeRide Health scaling calls with PolyAI.

employee_band.notes: PolyAI reports 250 employees, which falls in the requested 201-500 band: https://poly.ai/about.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The explicit headquarters-move announcement places the HQ at London's Paddington Central, agreeing with PitchBook: https://paddingtoncentral.com/latest/news/polyai-3-sheldon-square and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/227011-60. Conflicting San Francisco profile information prevents high confidence. | hq_country: PitchBook identifies London, United Kingdom, consistent with the explicit London headquarters-move announcement: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/227011-60 and https://paddingtoncentral.com/latest/news/polyai-3-sheldon-square. A conflicting San Francisco profile location lowers confidence.

founded_year.notes: PolyAI's About page explicitly gives 2017 as its founding year: https://poly.ai/about.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts explain how PolyAI builds its models: Owl fine-tuning by machine-learning engineer Tomasz Cichy (https://poly.ai/blog/owl-speech-recognition-model-polyai) and Dialog-RSN-1 architecture and training by VP Research Matt Henderson (https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-dialog-rsn-1). The latter author's title is research leadership rather than explicitly engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains product documentation and links to a quickstart and platform overview, rather than a single FAQ: http://docs.poly.ai/home.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live current-openings page lists 'Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI.' Its title contains AI and is an engineering—not AI-sales—role, meeting the specified title rule: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai. Evidence is the live vacancy listing rather than a separately inspected detail page.

model_provider.notes: PolyAI explicitly says its agents are powered by Raven, its proprietary dialog model: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai/jobs/4932846101. Although that vacancy has since closed, the published model disclosure remains evidence of the company's stated model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page publicly names all five compliance claims, including SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certification: https://poly.ai/security. These are reported as company claims, not independently verified certifications. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly claims ISO 27001 certification. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is named on the security page. | compliance_certs.3: GDPR is named on the security page. | compliance_certs.4: PCI DSS is named on the security page.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The most recent identified round is explicitly labeled Series D: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers. | funding_date: The identified Series D announcement is dated December 15, 2025, giving 2025-12: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers. | funding_amount_usd: The most recent identified funding announcement states an $86 million Series D: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers.

raised_18mo.notes: The $86 million Series D announced December 15, 2025 falls within the preceding 18 months: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists three openings: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI; Staff Product Manager; and Senior Marketing Manager. None is an SDR, BDR or account executive: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai. The previously indexed AE vacancy is no longer open.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 6, 2026, PolyAI announced Dialog-RSN-1 availability on AWS SageMaker, a model deployment offering launched within the preceding six months: https://poly.ai/blog/dialog-rsn-1-aws-sagemaker.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: PolyAI announced Sunil Shah's appointment as CFO on October 8, 2026, within the preceding 12 months: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-appoints-sunil-shah-cfo.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The GTM Systems job description explicitly identifies Salesforce as the center of its systems and names Outreach, Gong, HubSpot and Clay as surrounding tools: http://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai/jobs/4828275101. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job description says Salesforce is the center of PolyAI's GTM systems. | crm_stack_signal.1: Outreach is explicitly named in the surrounding GTM tool suite. | crm_stack_signal.2: Gong is explicitly named in the surrounding GTM tool suite. | crm_stack_signal.3: HubSpot is explicitly named in the surrounding GTM tool suite. | crm_stack_signal.4: Clay is explicitly named in the surrounding GTM tool suite.
